Commentary.Commentary: Right, then! That's it from this game. Zimbabwe might have lost this one, but they'll have to dust themselves off and get themselves ready as they take on Sri Lanka in the next encounter, on the 17th, which is in two day's time from now, at this same venue. Join us for that at 1200 local (0600 GMT). For now, however, there's a nail-biting game going on in Centurion between South Africa and India. Switch tabs and tune in for that exciting Test match. Cheers!

Man of the Match, Shakib Al Hasan says it was important to pick early wickets as the pitch got easier to bat later on. Mentions there was a bit of moisture early in the innings so that's why the plan was to start with spin and it paid off. On Tamim Iqbal, happily let's everybody know that he has been terrific for the last 2-3 years and hopes he can continue to do well. Says when you bat at No.3 you have more responsibilities and the team expects you to do well, so is just hoping he can keep putting up good performances.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says it was tough especially when they went to South Africa so is nice to come back home and win. Credits his bowlers for doing well. Knew that with only 170 to chase, there was never a doubt they would get the job done. Takes a moment to applaud Shakib Al Hasan and his efforts at No.3 and ends saying that he's pleased with the overall performance in today's game.

Zimbabwe skipper, Graeme Cremer says they didn't mind batting first. Reckons 250 was a par score but can't be batting like the way they did. States they have experienced guys in the team but goes on to say that lack of playing time really does affect performances. Feels there are still lots of games to play so can turn their fortunes around. Adds that if they got through those first 10 overs without much damage, they could put up a better score but that didn't happen. Ends saying that they want to do better in the next game.

A comfortable win for Bangladesh as they start this Tri-Series in the best possible manner. They first started off splendidly with the ball, wrapping the Zimbabwean batting order for 170 with everybody chipping in with the wickets barring Nasir Hossain. And then, chased the meagre target down with ease. Haque started briskly and departed cheaply, but the Iqbal-Shakib partnership consisting of 78 more or less sealed the deal. Mushfiqur Rahim came post Shakib's dismissal and then added the finishing touches to this run chase. A well-earned victory for the host nation. Zimbabwe didn't put up any kind of a fight, except for Sikandar Raza of course, so a lot of work is needed to be done if they wish to be competitive in this tournament.
There it is. BANGLADESH WIN BY 8 WICKETS! Mushfiqur Rahim works it away on the leg side and crosses over to the other end with ease.

FOUR! Tossed up around off, Rahim gets low to this one and slog sweeps it over square leg. Didn't connect as well, but it had enough legs to go across the boundary line. Bangladesh just a run away now from victory.
Loopy leg break on middle and off, worked with the spin in front of square leg for one.
Safe! Comfortably in this time. Tamim cuts it towards point and sets off for the run. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but the left-hander is safe.
It's another direct hit and once again it's Iqbal who is in question. Is he safe again?

Just in! Iqbal works it to backward square leg. It's Rahim who calls for the second and Tamim just reacts, albeit a little late. Rushes back as Taylor deflects the throw onto the stumps at his end. It's taken upstairs and replays show Tamim is safe.
A run out appeal against Tamim is taken upstairs. Could be touch and go...
We have a legal delivery here, folks! Iqbal gets a top edge as he slices it over point and gets a couple of runs.
Make that Free Hit No.4.
No ball! Poor guy. It's his debut after all, probably the nerves getting to him. He'll learn. Another no ball, wide outside off. Iqbal looks to connect but fails.
Third of the over. Yikes! One more Free Hit.
No ball! Oh, dear! That's not good. He's making huge blunders too, such a big margin. Fuller outside off, Iqbal goes for the drive through the covers but misses.
Another Free Hit coming up...
No ball! One more no ball. Overstepped by a huge margin again. Full outside off, blocked into the covers.
Works it down the leg side but rather comfortably. Single taken.
Short of a length around off, Rahim looks to cut but misses.
Free Hit coming up now...
No ball! Short and wide, Rahim looks to cut but finds point. But, it's a no ball. A big no ball. He's overstepped by a big margin there.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked away just wide of the man at mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Blessing Muzarabani to bowl again.
Flatter and shorter on the stumps, whipped off the back foot through to deep mid-wicket. Single to end the over.

FOUR! Sloppy effort from Kyle Jarvis. Iqbal drives this to the right of mid off. Jarvis there moves to his right, tries to make a tumbling stop but goes over the ball. It goes through him and away to the fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Too full in length, enable the southpaw to get forward and stop the ball in its tracks.
Spinning in from around off, plays with the spin to turn it on the leg side.
Floats it right up there, outside off, Iqbal plays it back in the bowler's direction.
Fullish and straight, played back to the bowler.
Top edge which falls safely. Loopy and full, Rahim is down to sweep but a top edge over the keeper's head and wide of short fine leg.
Wide! Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for the batsman. The Umpire signals a wide.
Plays with the spin and works it on the leg side.
Deft from Rahim. Straighter one, outside off, Rahim backs away a bit and guides it past the keeper. Runs hard and comes back for the second.
Short and wide, cut away square on the off side for one.
Spinning away from outside off, Tamim waits for it and plays this really late. Guides it down past short third man for a double.
Stays right behind the line, keeps bat and pad close together to block it out.
Knocks this full ball down to long off and crosses through.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SIX! Wrong 'un from Cremer and Iqbal has picked it up. Plants his front foot forward and dropkicks it over backward square leg for a biggie. Timed that perfection, beautifully hit.
Presses ahead to this full ball and keeps it out with a straight blade.

FOUR! A little comical out there. Blessing Muzarabani in the limelight here. Half-tracker outside off, Tamim hangs back and cuts it through backward point. Blessing moves to his right, dives and stops the ball, but it seems his foot has touched the rope. Replays confirm the same. But, before this was confirmed, the debutant funnily threw the ball somewhere not intended. Fell rather beside him really, not sure how that happened. Everyone has a laugh at that.
Quite full and fast this time, worked away down the ground, towards mid on for a single.
Goes with the spin again, another tuck on the on side.
As the ball spins into him, Rahim waits before turning it to mid-wicket.
Spinning in on middle stumps, swept away on the leg side. Won't get any run for it.

SIX! What. A. Hit. Take a bow, little genius! Seeing the ball with some flight on it, Mushfiqur Rahim decides to go for it. Skips down and smokes it straight back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Quicker one on off, Mushfiqur off the inner half defends it on the leg side.
Top edge over the keeper! Sees the flight and Tamim gets down to play the slog sweep. The ball takes the top edge and flies over Taylor and rolls behind. They collect two.
Tossed up delivery outside off, a mistimed drive towards mid off.
FOUR! Easy peasy for the southpaw! Cremer bowls it short and down the leg side, Tamim gets down on one knee and paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Dances down to the pitch of the ball and drags it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a brace.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads
Gets across and nails to sweep but it goes straight to the man at 45.

That's fifty for the veteran! Typical Tamim innings, this! Slow and steady! Taps this delivery towards point and scampers through for a quick single. Raises the bat and gets a huge round of applause. For the record, it's his 39th ODI fifty!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Edgyyyy! Tamim won't mind it though! Raza bowls it quicker through the air outside off, Iqbal goes back to force it through the off side but ekes out a thick edge past the vacant slip cordon for a boundary towards third man.

FOUR! Sloppy from Solomon Mire! Raza tosses it up on middle and leg, Tamim skips down the track, takes it on the full and whips it towards mid on. Mire moves across to his left but lets it slip through his legs. The ball races down to the fence.
Comes down the track, Raza fires it on the stumps, Tamim does well to jam it out towards cover.
Flighted ball around off, Tamim with a stride forward kills it down.
Drifting in on middle an leg, wristed towards the fielder at mid on for nothing.
Flattish and served outside off, Rahim makes a leave.
Very full on off, Tamim digs it out to long on to get off strike.
Almost a return catch! Cremer bowls a googly, Tamim looks to work it away but gets a soft leading edge which goes on the bounce to the bowler.
Goes back and defends it with a straight bat.
Loopy delivery outside off, Tamim presses forward in defense.
A wicket maiden! Well bowled, Raza! Tossed up around off, Rahim prods forward in defense.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Rahim pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven towards cover.
Tossed up on off, worked off the back foot to square leg.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! Three reds! Excellent review from Zimbabwe! Actually from Sikandar Raza. He was the only one who looked confident and convinced his captain to opt for the DRS! He comes from around the wicket and bowls a slider which skids off the surface. Shakib looks to defend but misses to get pinged on the front pad. A loud appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Zimbabwe challenge the on-field call. There is no bat involved and Hawk Eye shows it's pitching in line and would have hit the leg stump. The decision is overturned! Raza with another wicket to his name.
Another review! This time it's against Shakib Al Hasan! Sikandar Raza convinces his skipper to take the review for an LBW...
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.

FOUR! It's played off the gloves off the keeper! Quicker one from Crmer, Tamim makes room and opens the bat face at the very last moment to get it finer. The man at short third man did give it a chase but to no avail.
The batsman goes for the sweep but fails to connect it.

NOT OUT! Clearly no bat! Wonder why did umpire feel the other way. Spinning down leg again, Tamim goes back and looks to tuck it away. Looked like he gets beaten and the keeper behind the stumps collects and starts to appeal. The umpire agrees and rules it out. Tamim is quick to the DRS. Replays show it's clear daylight between bat and ball.
Dear me! Tamim Iqbal is given out caught down the leg side. Seemed like he has missed it by a mile but the umpire, however, raises the finger. Tamim immediately signals 'T'!
Wide! Turning down leg, Tamim misses his flick. The keeper collects and appeal but the umpire stretches his hands to rightly call it a wide.
Slips in a googly, skidding off the surface. Tamim crouches low to dab it away but fails to get any wood on it.
Gives it a nice loop, lands it around off. Tamim gets across to bring out the big sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Loopy leg break around middle, Tamim wrists it with the turn in front of square leg. Looks for the single but it is not on.

Drinks! Bangladesh are motoring along quite well. They need just 69 more to register a win here. The experienced duo of Tamim and Shakib is doing the churning work with ease and are putting the bad balls away. Both look set to get to their respective fifties. Only a matter of time is what one would feel would require from the Bangla Tigers to finish things off...
Quicker and flatter through the air, Shakib looks to cut but it's too close to play that shot. Chops it towards the backward point fielder.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets forward and across to flick it away.
Sloppy from Zimbabwe! Tamim drives it through cover and crosses over. The man in the deep returns a wayward throw to the keeper who fails to collect it. They take two extra.
Very full on the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Comes from around the wicket, lands it around off, turning away. Shakib comes forward to defend but gets beaten by the away turn.
Wide! Looks to get down and broom it away but misses it completely.
Leg break, turning back in, wristed behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Slapped away! Cremer drags his length back a touch, Shakib is quick to sit back and time the cut behind point. A boundary results!
Loopy delivery outside off, milked down to long on for a comfortable single.
Leans forward on this delivery but there is a bit of extra bounce for the Zimbabwe skipper which takes the gloves of Iqbal and rolls towards short fine leg.
Floated delivery outside off, blocked off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit fuller around middle and leg, Shakib looks to whip but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a single.
Loops it up around middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single.
Got away with that one! Another one on the shorter side, Shakib camps back and punches it powerfully but finds Cremer at extra cover.
Good running! Tamim leans ahead and pushes it towards point for a brisk single.
FOUR! Makes the most of the loosener! Raza drops it short and it's outside off, Tamim transfers his weight on the back foot and punches it through the packed off side field for a boundary.
Flighted delivery around leg, tapped off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
Floats it up around middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Sikandar Raza is back on.
Works it off the pads, on the leg side for nothing.
Flatter ball around off, hangs back and pats it to point.
Some extra bounce outside off, not turning much, it's guided just wide of the short third man fielder by standing tall. One run taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The floodlights have been switched on. It's gone a bit dark out there, mostly the fog due to the cold weather.
Plants his front foot forward, gets closer to the pitch and picks up a single through backward square leg. Single taken.
Spinning in from around off, Tamim goes back and works it on the leg side.
Finally Graeme Cremer is into the attack.
Iqbal drives this full delivery through the covers and retains strike.
The 50-run stand between Iqbal and Shakib is up! Works it in front of mid-wicket and a single is taken. Bangladesh are cruising along here. No trouble for them as things stand.
FOUR! Stupendous stroke! Gets a juicy full toss which he gleefully dispatches. Through extra cover and away to the boundary line.
Full outside off, driven towards sweeper cover for one.

This one bounced and almost got Shakib Al Hasan! There's the unpredictable nature of the pitch. Shoots off a length on off, Shakib gets a leading edge and it spoons towards point. Falls just short of Raza running in to take it. Single taken.
Length ball just around off, doesn't bounce as much, kept out comfortably from inside the crease.
Length ball outside off, arms are shouldered to end the over.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Shortish in length, outside off, Iqbal taps and runs. Drops it into the off side gently and gets the run easily.
Angling in on middle and leg, touch short in length, the batsman swivels and pulls it along the ground through backward square leg. Single taken as the man in the deep mops it up.
Sweetly timed again. Shakib Al Hasan stands tall to this full ball and drives it to the man at mid off.
Quite full in length, just outside off, driven hard but straight to the man at cover.
Wide! Starts off from around the wicket and fires it full, but it's way outside off and across the tramline, so the umpire doesn't have any hesitation to stretch his arms and signal wide.
Hits that really well but straight to the fielder. Tamim cuts hard, seeing the width available to him, but can't get it past point.
Tamim Iqbal has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery on off, walks a step across and turns it through square leg. One run to the total.
Taps it down in front of cover. Thinks of taking the single but then decides against it.
He's feeling it. Going after everything now. Wide again outside off, Shakib throws his bat at it in an attempt to cut it away, but ends up making no connection.
Waits for the ball to come to him, opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for a single.

FOUR! 12 off the over, a big one for Bangladesh. So elegant with his timing, is Shakib. Be careful when he's in his groove. Fuller ball outside off, it's driven through the covers for the third boundary of the over.
FOUR! These are freebies you cannot give away, especially to a player like Shakib Al Hasan. Wide outside off, the all-rounder smacks it through the gap in the covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Room on offer for Shakib and he puts this away. Short and wide outside off, he slaps the cut over backward point and finds the boundary, beating the third man fielder looking to cut it off.
Stays back and blocks it out.
Quite close to off, on a good length, defended into the off side gently.
Back of a length around off, Shakib looks to cut but gets a bottom edge beside the stumps. Clear he needs some time in the middle. Fortunately for him, he has plenty today.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle.
Full toss on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and straight from Raza, it's played back to him with a straight blade.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full again, in line of the stumps, driven to mid on. No run this time.
Quite full in length, wristed down to long on for a single.
Spin for Raza! Good delivery, this. Dropped around off, spinning away, Shakib goes for the cut and misses again.
On middle and leg, Al Hasan brings his wrists into play and works it towards fine leg to retain strike.
Stays within his crease and keeps it out off the back foot.
Length ball, close to off, Tamim with soft hands blocks it in front of cover and calls his partner through.
No idea why he's going after that one. Short and wide, Shakib throws his bat at that and gets a top edge down towards third man. Single taken.
Fuller in length again, stump-to-stump line, driven back down the ground and a quick single is taken.
Blessing makes this length ball angle away from Tamim Iqbal, the batsman punches it to point.
Blessing Muzarabani is brought into the attack.
Full and fired on the stumps, played back down the track to end the over.
Some turn on this as Raza pitches it around off, Shakib plays it towards point off the outer half. Opened the bat face a little there.
Wide! Down the leg side again, Shakib misses his attempted sweep shot. It's a wide.
Comes forward and knocks this full ball to mid off for nothing.
Full in length and on the pads, Shakib pushes it back down the track.
Slider from the offie, Iqbal works it away into the leg side for a single.
Floats it up around off, Iqbal plants his front foot forward and keeps it out.
Five Wides! Fired down the leg side, Iqbal plays the sweep and misses and so does the keeper. It goes behind and away to the fence for a boundary.
Another whip. Picks it from around off and places it in front of square on the leg side. Single to the scoreboard.
Stays back and keeps this one out.
Good length ball outside off, moves across his sticks and whips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Just behind a good length, in the off stump channel, blocked.
Very well adjusted by Tamim Iqbal. Well done. Very well done. Short of a length delivery but it keeps really, really low. He still manages to help the pull square on the leg side and take two.
Length delivery shaping away, around off, Iqbal stays inside his crease and blocks it out.
Short and flat again, outside off, Shakib connects with the cut this time and finds gap too. Two runs will be earned.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Beaten! Short and wide outside off, Shakib looks to fiercely cut this but can't connect. Rahim collects and appeals, but nothing from the umpire.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Bit of flight on this from Raza, Shakib goes back and punches it to long off. One run taken.
Quite full from Raza, easy enough for Tamim to push it down to long off and get off strike.
Full ball which is sweetly timed on the drive. Unfortunately for Shakib, he finds the man at mid off.
Back of a length around off, Shakib gets an inside edge which falls near the off stick. Close, could have just as easily dragged it back onto the stumps.
Places it in the gap this time. Works it to mid-wicket and crosses over.
Too straight in line, Tamim nudges it away but finds the man on the leg side.
Touch fuller in length, Iqbal hits it straight back and Jarvis stops it in his followthrough.
Good length delivery outside off, defended into the off side with soft hands.
Shakib Al Hasan walks in at No.3.

OUT! RAZA STRIKES! Is there nothing this man can't do? Did so well with the bat first, now delivers with the ball. And credit to Cremer too for the smart field placement. Just one man out over on the leg side, Haque goes down and slog sweeps, connects well but finds deep mid-wicket, the only fielder on the leg side, to perfection. Craig Ervine makes no mistake in taking that catch. Zimbabwe have their first breakthrough.

Appeal for an lbw, turned down! The inside edge saved him there. Quicker one on the stumps, catches Haque on the pads but not before taking the inside edge. The umpire spotted that and made a good decision.
Plays with the spin and works it away on the leg side.
Full ball around off, pushed back down to mid on.
FOUR! Anamul Haque will stop at nothing! Raza from over the wicket floats it up there, Haque sweeps with the turn and clears backward square leg with ease. Another boundary to his name.
From around the wicket, it's tossed up outside off, eased down to long off for an easy single.
Sikandar Raza into the attack now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quite full in length, outside off, driven through the cover region for a single.
Stays well inside his crease and defends it with the full face of the bat.
Angling in on a bit of a fuller length, wristed towards mid on for a brisk run.
Hit that right off the middle again, straight back to the bowler this time. Haque drives it hard to Jarvis who stops it in his followthrough.
Good delivery! Late movement for Kyle Jarvis. Serves it on a length outside off and makes it go away, Anamul Haque chases after and almost nicks it too. He'd be smart to be wary of that.
Outside off on a good length, Tamim hangs his bat inside the line as the ball goes into the keeper's gloves.
FOUR! Wonderful stroke from Tamim Iqbal! Full ball outside the line of off stump, it's driven crisply through the gap in the covers for a boundary.
Nicely done by Tamim. Fraction straight in line, it's worked through square leg. There is a slip from Cremer while collecting the ball and hence, the batsmen are able to take the second.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Coming back in on middle and leg, worked away off the pads through backward square leg for a run.
Free Hit coming up...
FOUR! And it's a no ball too for overstepping. Short and wide, Haque flays it square through point and finds the fence yet again. He's looking so confident, all his shots have been imperious so far.
FOUR! He is in supreme touch here! What a shot! Full and angling in, Haque lofts it handsomely over mid-wicket and sends it all the way for a boundary.
Tendai Chatara to bowl from the other end.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Exquisite shot! Beautiful to watch. Full, too full, on the stumps, Haque drives it straight back down the ground for a boundary.
Some extra bounce for Kyle Jarvis! Almost takes Tamim Iqbal by surprise. Short around off, rising sharply as the southpaw fends it awkwardly past the slip cordon. Single taken. He's off the mark.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Wide! Way outside off, it's across the tramline and that will be a wide.
Lands it on a good length outside off, Tamim has nothing to do with that.
Fuller length ball just outside off, kept out off the front foot.

We are back! Should be a relatively easy chase for the hosts, barring a horrendous collapse or something miraculous from Zimbabwe. Kyle Jarvis will open the bowling for the visitors while Tamim Iqbal and Anamul Haque open with the bat for Bangladesh. Two slips in place. Here we go...
